corpus: all 116 markdown documents selected by the frozen Experiment A source commit and path-hash rule; calibration, heldout, and trajectory documents are embedded, but no text is generated
chronology: first git-touch timestamp at or before source_commit; ties broken by sha256(path)
region_definition: deterministic spherical k-means over the midpoint of the two baseline-aligned canonical vectors, fit once on the final frozen corpus
normalized_hazard: mean fraction of k neighbors replaced divided by the exchangeable expectation added/(previous_n - 1 + added)
primary_endpoint: mean absolute cross-observer difference in normalized neighborhood-churn hazard over chronological insertion steps
regional_endpoint: mean absolute cross-observer difference in normalized hazard over region-by-step cells
nonstationarity_endpoint: mean cosine distance between each arriving batch centroid and the previous-prefix centroid, averaged over the two frozen observers
null_model: exchangeable insertion: 128 shared random permutations of the same final corpus and fixed observer geometries

hubness_controls.fit_policy: fit the score correction once on the final frozen corpus, then hold it fixed during insertion replay so correction statistics do not themselves become a second moving process

mutual_proximity.mode: exact empirical Mutual Proximity on the final cosine-distance matrix

hubness_controls.dbnorm_note: DBNorm is not a primary control here because its published setting uses distinct query and gallery banks in cross-modal retrieval. Treating one symmetric corpus as both banks would be an unvalidated method adaptation. CSLS and exact empirical Mutual Proximity provide two established, structurally appropriate hubness-control families.

gap_mechanism: before each insertion batch, record the top-1 cosine gap and the k-versus-(k+1) boundary gap; compare churn rates in the lowest and highest boundary-gap quartiles
resolution: for anchors present at initial_n, record added documents and added final-corpus mass until the first kNN change, with right-censoring when no change occurs

decision_rule.stationary_null_not_rejected: nonstationarity endpoint p >= alpha; do not interpret churn as a corpus-flow phenomenon
decision_rule.dynamic_transfer_not_rejected: nonstationarity detected but raw cross-observer dynamic-divergence p >= alpha
decision_rule.model_specific_relational_dynamics: nonstationarity detected, raw divergence p < alpha, and divergence remains p < alpha under every hubness control that reduces k-occurrence skewness in both observers
decision_rule.hubness_sensitive: nonstationarity detected and raw divergence p < alpha, but at least one effective hubness control makes divergence non-significant

interpretation_rule: The encoders are frozen. A document vector never moves. The only dynamical object is corpus-induced relational structure (neighbor identity/rank, hubness-corrected neighbor identity, and region-level churn). Static alignment is inherited context, not selected from these outcomes.
